### demo.slice
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo.slice
[Unit]
Description=demo (systemd-compose project)

[Slice]
MemoryMax=2G

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml

### demo-db.service
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo-db.service
[Unit]
Description=demo: db
PartOf=demo.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
WorkingDirectory=@DIR@
ExecStart=@BIN@/psql -c "select 1"
Slice=demo.slice
SyslogIdentifier=demo-db

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Service=db
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml

### demo-api.service
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo-api.service
[Unit]
Description=the api, described by hand
PartOf=demo.target
Requires=demo-api.socket
After=demo-db.service
Requires=demo-db.service
After=network-online.target

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=@DIR@/app
Environment=PORT=8080
Environment="GREETING=hello world"
Environment="QUOTED=say \"hi\""
Environment=PCT=100%%
EnvironmentFile=@DIR@/.env
EnvironmentFile=-@DIR@/.env.local
ExecStart=@BIN@/node server.mjs --port 8080
ExecStartPost=/opt/systemd-compose probe --interval 10s --timeout 2s --retries 5 --start-period 30s --start-interval 1s -- @BIN@/curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/health
TimeoutStartSec=37s
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3s
Slice=demo.slice
SyslogIdentifier=demo-api
MemoryMax=512M
CPUQuota=50%
TasksMax=64
TimeoutStopSec=10

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Service=api
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml
RestartTriggers=bb696238bb0e8c11

### demo-worker.service
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo-worker.service
[Unit]
Description=demo: worker
PartOf=demo.target
After=demo-api.service
Requires=demo-api.service

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=@DIR@
Environment=MODE=batch
ExecStart=@BIN@/node worker.mjs
Restart=always
Slice=demo.slice
SyslogIdentifier=demo-worker

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Service=worker
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml

### demo-cache.service
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo-cache.service
[Unit]
Description=demo: cache
PartOf=demo.target
After=demo-db.service
Wants=demo-db.service
After=demo-api.service

After=demo-worker.service
Requires=demo-worker.service

[Service]
WorkingDirectory=@DIR@
ExecStart=@BIN@/node cache.mjs
Slice=demo.slice
SyslogIdentifier=demo-cache

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Service=cache
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml

### demo-backup.service
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo-backup.service
[Unit]
Description=demo: backup
PartOf=demo.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=@DIR@
ExecStart=@BIN@/backup --all
Slice=demo.slice
SyslogIdentifier=demo-backup
SuccessExitStatus=2

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Service=backup
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml

### demo-backup.timer
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo-backup.timer
[Unit]
Description=demo: backup (timer)
PartOf=demo.target

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:00:00
AccuracySec=10s
Persistent=yes
RandomizedDelaySec=5min
OnBootSec=1min

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Service=backup
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml

### demo-api.socket
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo-api.socket
[Unit]
Description=demo: api (socket)
PartOf=demo.target

[Socket]
ListenStream=127.0.0.1:8080
ListenStream=@DIR@/run/api.sock
Backlog=64

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Service=api
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml

### demo.target
# Rendered by systemd-compose from @DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml; up rewrites it.
# A local change belongs in a drop-in: systemctl --user edit demo.target
[Unit]
Description=demo (systemd-compose project)
Wants=demo-db.service
Wants=demo-api.socket
Wants=demo-api.service
Wants=demo-worker.service
Wants=demo-cache.service
Wants=demo-backup.timer

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

[X-SystemdCompose]
Project=demo
Config=@DIR@/systemd-compose.yaml
